descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Authorized Officer, Quant Services Consultant in Weehawken, NJ.

Are you an innovative thinker? Are you focused on the details, even when under pressure? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions?

We’re looking for an Authorized Officer, Quant Services Consultant to:
• Contribute to the development, implementation and validation of quantitative models. Drive quantitative projects for all business divisions and group functions.
• Perform statistical data analysis including regression models and time series analyses to transform real-world data into meaningful results for the bank. Review the appropriateness of input data, model assumptions, parameters, and calibration accuracy as well as qualitative or expert adjustments.
• Drive transformation and change across the firm. Actively increase the capabilities and performance of the team, to meet business needs. Communicate effectively with all audiences in a structured manner and collaborate with diverse teams to reach the best solution.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001445. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V. #LI-DNI

Salary & Work Schedule: $112,778 to $125,000 Per Year, 40 hrs/wk. The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.
